title: Earnings Statement Glossary: The Largest Instant Cashout
content:
**Largest instant cashout.** Under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**, the largest instant cashout to an external debit card is the available balance on the earnings account less the cashout fee, capped at the daily cashout limit less the instant cashouts already made today. The daily cashout limit is the daily instant cashout maximum of the product's instant cashout schedule, and the cashout fee is the external debit card cashout fee of that schedule under the driver's Wayfare Pro status for the quarter. The largest instant cashout is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, and is never below zero.

## Terms used in the definition

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Available balance | The balance on the earnings account at the moment of the cashout |
| Cashout fee | The external debit card cashout fee for the driver's Wayfare Pro status for the quarter, in the instant cashout schedule |
| Daily cashout limit | The daily instant cashout maximum in the instant cashout schedule |
| Instant cashouts already made today | The total of the instant cashouts on the earnings statement dated today, the calendar day in the driver's market time, counted at their cashout amounts before fees |
| Cap | The daily cashout limit less the instant cashouts already made today |
| Largest instant cashout | The smaller of the available balance less the cashout fee, rounded half up to the cent, and the cap; never below zero |

## Worked figures on hypothetical inputs

Every row below is a hypothetical account; the inputs are chosen for illustration only.

| Available balance | Cashout fee | Daily cashout limit | Cashed out today | Balance less fee | Cap | Largest instant cashout |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 640.00 | 0.85 | 500.00 | 120.00 | 639.15 | 380.00 | 380.00 |
| 210.30 | 0.85 | 500.00 | 0.00 | 209.45 | 500.00 | 209.45 |
| 0.50 | 0.85 | 500.00 | 0.00 | -0.35 | 500.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) |
| 300.00 | 1.25 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 298.75 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
